first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single human-shaped subject continuously visible in the air between the buildings, wearing close-fitting clothing; in later poses, a red head and blue torso and legs are discernible.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: Gray clouds above the city and in the gaps between the upper portions of the buildings.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: Gray and reddish-brown buildings of varying heights, along with a slender dark glass high-rise slightly left of center.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: A gray street passage extending from the lower part of the image into the distance between the buildings, partially occluded by tree canopies and buildings.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green tree canopies distributed along both sides of the road and between the buildings.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: Graphic and textual advertising areas on the exterior walls of the buildings, of which the rectangular main sign with black text on a light-colored background and a red horizontal strip below is the most prominent.
